The equation for the reaction of magnesium with dilute sulfuric acid is shown.
Mg  +  H2SO4→  MgSO4  +  H2
[Mr:  MgSO4, 120]
Which mass of magnesium sulfate is formed when 12g of magnesium completely reacts with
dilute sulfuric acid?
A
5g
B
10g
C
60g
D
120g
